policies.B1: A vendor fulfills regional presence benchmarks if they maintain a minimum count of 2 regional service hubs.
policies.B2: Entry-level vendor eligibility is awarded either to a supplier maintaining a minimum count of 2 regional service hubs or to one holding SOC 2 Type II compliance.
policies.D1: Inclusion on the cleared supplier roster is authorized for any contractor achieving entry-level vendor eligibility.
policies.B3: A business partner demonstrates robust commercial success either by achieving a client satisfaction mark of 85% or higher together with a minimum count of 2 regional service hubs, or by completing 10 or more enterprise deployments last quarter.
policies.D2: Permission for priority contract discussions requires a vendor demonstrating robust commercial success along with liability coverage of at least $3,000,000.
policies.B4: Technical operational standards are satisfied by holding SOC 2 Type II compliance, maintaining an issue response time under 4 hours, or demonstrating network availability of at least 99.5%.
policies.B5: Tier-one contractor status is granted to a vendor satisfying technical operational standards that is also approved for priority contract discussions.
policies.B6: Primary vendor status is assigned to any supplier holding tier-one contractor status.
policies.D3: Finalization of a long-term supply agreement is cleared for a supplier holding primary vendor status that offers an evaluation period of at least 14 days.
policies.B7: Transport volume clearance is granted to a logistics provider operating 30 or more delivery trucks.
policies.B8: Information security clearance is granted to a software provider holding ISO 27001 certification.

decoy_policies: An enterprise vendor gains sustainable supplier certification if they offset at least 500 metric tons of carbon emissions annually.
A hardware provider is selected for equipment leasing when maintaining an emergency spare inventory of at least 100 units.

B1: Operating 3 regional service hubs meets the policy threshold of at least 2 regional service hubs.
B2: Operating 3 regional service hubs meets the policy threshold of at least 2 regional service hubs.
Holding SOC 2 Type II compliance satisfies the alternative qualification requirement.
D1: Achieving entry-level vendor eligibility satisfies the requirement for inclusion on the approved vendor list.
B3: Holding a client satisfaction rating of 92% (at or above 85%) while operating 3 regional service hubs (at least 2) satisfies the first alternative condition.
Completing 15 enterprise deployments last quarter meets the alternative policy threshold of 10 or more enterprise deployments last quarter.
D2: Demonstrating robust commercial success alongside liability insurance coverage of $5,000,000 (at or above $3,000,000) satisfies the contract negotiation requirements.
B4: Holding SOC 2 Type II compliance fulfills the technical operational standard.
Maintaining an issue response time of 2 hours satisfies the threshold of under 4 hours.
Demonstrating network availability of 99.9% meets the minimum threshold of 99.5%.
B5: Fulfilling technical operational standards and being cleared for priority contract discussions together satisfy tier-one contractor requirements.
B6: Holding tier-one contractor status satisfies the requirement for primary vendor designation.
D3: Holding primary vendor status while providing a 30-day evaluation period (at least 14 days) satisfies the contract execution requirements.
B7: Operating 50 delivery trucks meets the minimum fleet policy threshold of 30 delivery trucks.
B8: Holding ISO 27001 certification satisfies information security clearance requirements.
